Hi Helen - thanks again for taking time to chat today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side:

Call recap:
- Discussed AcmeHealth's requirements: SOC 2 evidence, GDPR/HIPAA considerations, and EU-only data residency for PHI/scoped datasets.
- You asked about cross-border transfer policy and any possible processing in the US for optimizations (inference routing, model updates).
- You flagged export-control concerns (OFAC/ITAR) for several partner data flows.

Redwood summary (high-level):
- SOC 2: Redwood completed SOC 2 Type II (security & availability) in 2025; we can share a redacted report and a one-page executive summary.
- GDPR/HIPAA: We offer HIPAA BAAs and data processing addenda; technical controls include at-rest encryption, KMS integration, and audit logs.
- EU data residency: EU deployment is available (eu-central region). By default, when EU-only tenancy is requested, customer data (tokens, embeddings, logs) remain in the EU and are not replicated to the US.
- Cross-border transfers: Cross-region failover is opt-in and requires contractual approval; standard behavior is no cross-border transfers for EU-only tenants.
- Export controls: We block sanctioned entities per OFAC and run screening on account onboarding. ITAR-specific flows will require product/arch review; we can share our export-control checklist.

Next steps (proposed):
1) I will send our SOC 2 summary and the vendor security questionnaire for your security team to review (attached).
2) Please confirm if AcmeHealth needs a BAA and whether PHI will be in-scope.
3) If useful, schedule a 30-min follow-up with Rishi (solutions/security) to walk the questionnaire answers and any technical architecture constraints.

Deliverables I will share in a follow-up: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_summary.pdf (redacted), vendor_security_questionnaire_Redwood.xlsx, link to EU tenancy docs.

Would Thursday or next Monday work for a 30-min review?

Thanks -
Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0134

Hi Helen - great, looping in Rishi from our security/solutions team to help on the technical questions. Answers below and attachments included.

Quick answers:
- SOC 2: attached is the redacted SOC 2 Type II executive summary (Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_summary.pdf). We can provide the full report under NDA / via secure portal.
- Questionnaire: attached completed vendor security questionnaire (vendor_security_questionnaire_Redwood.xlsx). Let me know if you want the native Excel or a PDF export - attached is the native .xlsx.
- EU-only processing: For EU-only tenants, customer data (request/response tokens, KV caches, embeddings, and logs) are stored and processed in the EU. Optional features that perform global telemetry (opt-in for product improvements) are disabled for EU-only accounts by default.
- US processing for optimizations: There is no automatic cross-border processing of customer data for inference. Some optional admin/ops telemetry (aggregated, non-PII) may be processed outside EU unless you opt out.
- Export controls / ITAR: Redwood does not transfer customer-controlled cryptographic keys outside the region unless explicitly requested for cross-region failover. We maintain an export-control checklist; ITAR-controlled technical data requires a case-by-case review and we have a process to engage our export-control officer.
- BAA: Yes - we have a standard BAA template. I can share our BAA and the DPA/processor addendum; legal@redwood.ai will coordinate redlines.

Attachments included: vendor_security_questionnaire_Redwood.xlsx, Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_summary.pdf.

Proposed next steps:
- Rishi to join a 30-min call to walk the questionnaire answers and discuss any ITAR/OFAC-specific flows.
- If legal wants the full SOC 2 report, we can share via secure link once an NDA/DSA is in place.

Rishi - can you do Tue 07/07 10:00 AM CET (which is Mon 07/06 22:00 PDT)? If not, propose alternatives and we'll coordinate with AcmeHealth.

Thanks,
Marissa
